context.pivot_statement: Pivot the decisive-thrust question from literature/simulation to a controlled common-hardware experiment while modelling continues in parallel. Two separate decisions: (1) absolute thrust feasibility on the actual atmospheric feed within P_bus < 1.5 kW (T_measured; sustained >= 12 mN; the registered 25 mN capability condition); (2) architecture discrimination via R_arch = (T/P_bus)_{RF|ECR+Hall} / (T/P_bus)_{Hall-only} on one Hall accelerator H-1, one cathode C-1, same magnetic circuit, V_d, feed state, facility and diagnostics, changing only the pre-ionizer (HW-0 / HW-RF / HW-ECR). Sequence: Phase 1 Hall-only sustainment knee on N2 first; Phase 2 common-condition three-arm comparison; Phase 3 absolute thrust demonstration across the representative feed envelope. Experiment path: resolve D-01..D-15 -> LOCK-1 -> hardware and instrumentation -> S1 qualification -> LOCK-2 from measured S1 noise/calibration -> only then score-bearing comparison. Do not simplify the paired design. Part of the new measurements are pre-registered, before any data, as held-out Hall-transport validation evidence (new evidence; P5-N2 v1 unchanged and INCONCLUSIVE).
